'''Smoke Rush''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 50 to be cast and can inflict a maximum of 13 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Smoke Rush is capable of [[poison]]ing a target at a 1/8 chance on hit, having a [[poison severity]] of 10 (where poison starts at 2 damage every 30 [[Tick|ticks]] or 18 seconds); this can be increased to 11 with an [[ancient sceptre]]. Increasing the total poison damage to 18 (first hit does 3 damage), instead of 15.

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

It is the weakest of the [[smoke spells]], and also the weakest [[combat spell]] of the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook.
